# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** roughly fifty (in volume 4)  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose is a large man who resembled an ancient Viking while dancing, complete with long hair and a beard. For fifteen years he remained unshaven with untrimmed hair in fulfillment of a political vow, until the Liberal victory allowed him to finally cut his hair and beard.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v5 c9 P14](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0014)_

## Personality

Ambrose is exceedingly resolute and obstinate, possessing a somewhat quick temper and a tendency to make outrageous statements or take serious matters lightly. However, he is also clever, well-read, twinkly, hearty, and an entertaining storyteller. He is deeply outraged by any mistreatment of children.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P14](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0014), [v5 c26 P11](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0011), [v5 c27 P6](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0006)_

## History

Ambrose Kerr grew up as a passionate Grit in a political family. During a fierce general election fifteen years before meeting Nell, he publicly swore not to shave his face or cut his hair until the Liberals returned to power. He maintained this oath for fifteen years, looking strikingly like an ancient Viking. On New Year's Eve, he joined Captain Saul and others at the lighthouse, entertaining them with stories, singing Scotch ballads in his tenor voice, and dancing elegantly with Lorna Vane. When the Liberals finally won the election, Ambrose forced the barber Gus to give him a haircut and shave before sunrise; his newly clean-shaven appearance shocked his elderly housekeeper so severely that she fainted. Soon after, he married Miss Winifred Tolley. They settled down together in a comfortable greenish-gray house between the Glen and Seven Gulls Point, which Ambrose had landscaped with planted trees, a spruce hedge, and a rose garden. When reports reached his wife concerning the mistreatment of an orphan named Mary by Mrs. Grimble over-harbour, Ambrose traveled across the water to investigate, becoming enraged at the details of the child's abuse.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P12](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0012)_
